description: Known cross-platform drift for flutter (A9.2: recorded, not changed, in this program). `expectations` maps each expectations file (by name) and case file to text that names every field that differs, as "field: why". A conformance test passes a case when flutter matches `expected`, or differs only in a field its entry names; the entry is removed in the change that fixes the drift. `other` records verified drift no expectations case pins. Only the flutter unit edits this file.

other.localizedListings: No localized-listings support: LOCALIZED_LISTINGS is ignored (fixtures/app-config/valid/localized-json-text.json and localized-object.json). The expectations do not hold flutter to localizedListings, so no case entry.
other.listing.text: SellwildListing.fromJson writes an integral JSON double as '20.0' where the JS clients write '20' (huge numbers differ too: an int keeps every digit).
other.listing.hasPhoto: has_photo counts any non-zero number as true, including 2 and NaN; only the text 'true' or '1' counts as true.
other.listing.user: A numeric user.id or membershipType is read as text and the listing is kept; the schema wants text, and iOS drops the listing.
other.config.unreadNumbers: SellwildSDK.apply ignores contract-valid numbers it has no reader for and keeps the base value, without a failure report: a numeric BANNER_ZID, BOTTOM_BANNER_ZID or MOBILE_BANNER_ZID (the schema allows string or number), an integral JSON double such as 5.0 for an integer key (AD_REFRESH_MAX and the other integer keys), and a fractional MARGIN_BOTTOM (the schema says number). Values the schema rejects are reported as config.field.invalid.
other.config.iabCatsText: Text IAB_CATS is contract-valid and ignored (the iabCats cases above); SellwildSDK.apply does not report it, so the real weatherbug config reports no failure. A list with items that are not text keeps the text items and reports config.field.invalid.
other.bridge.adImpressionZoneId: An AD_IMPRESSION bridge message with a numeric zoneId (fixtures/bridge-message/valid/ad-impression-number-zone.json) does not reach onAdImpression, which takes text, as before (then a swallowed TypeError). It is contract-valid, so it is not a failure report: SellwildWidget traces it to the debug logger. iOS passes '' and Android the number as text.
other.card.cssColor: SellwildListingCard uses PRICE_COLOR and PRICE_FONT_COLOR only when they are #rrggbb (or rrggbb). Other CSS colors the schema allows as text, such as 'red', '#fff' or 'rgb(0,0,0)', show grey and are reported as config.color.invalid (severity error) once per config. The widget page takes any CSS color. The native feeds also reject 3-digit #rgb: Android FeedTheme.resolve (Color.parseColor throws; fallback and config.color.invalid) and iOS SellwildFeedView.parseColor (6 or 8 digits only; fallback), so Flutter keeps grey for '#fff' rather than expanding it, which would be Flutter-only drift. Android's Color.parseColor does take named colors and #aarrggbb, which Flutter does not.
